description: This Java class 'GeoLocationUtils' provides a utility method to retrieve the client's IP address from an HttpServletRequest object by checking various HTTP headers that may contain the IP. It is used within web applications to determine the client's origin IP address, considering proxies and forwarding headers.

classes.name: GeoLocationUtils
classes.description: Utility class providing method to extract client IP address from HTTP request headers.

methods.name: getClientIpAddress
methods.description: Retrieves the client's IP address by examining various HTTP headers and fallback to request's remote address.
